definitions.explanation: A group, organization, or opinion breaking apart into opposing factions. Implies conflict or disagreement.
The splitting of cells or atomic nuclei in scientific contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政党|せいとう}→政党：04338_seitou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{分裂|ぶんれつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対立|たいりつ}→対立：04500_tairitsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{分裂|ぶんれつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The team split apart due to conflicting opinions.

examples.japanese: {党内|とうない}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{分裂|ぶんれつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深|ふか}まり→深まる：02406_fukamaru⟧、⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えた→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: The internal party split deepened and had a major impact on the election.

がん⟦{細胞|さいぼう}→細胞：05030_saibou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{通常|つうじょう}→通常：27316_tsuujou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{細胞|さいぼう}→細胞：05030_saibou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{速|はや}く→速い：00514_hayai⟧{分裂|ぶんれつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Cancer cells divide faster than normal cells.

examples.english: Enormous energy is released through nuclear fission.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧ (to divide) + {裂|れつ} (to tear, to rip). Carries a stronger, more negative connotation than ⟦{分割|ぶんかつ}→分割：11745_bunkatsu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {分裂|ぶんれつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to split, to divide)
- ⟦{政党|せいとう}→政党：04338_seitou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{分裂|ぶんれつ} (party split)
- ⟦{細胞|さいぼう}→細胞：05030_saibou⟧{分裂|ぶんれつ} (cell division)
- {核|かく}{分裂|ぶんれつ} (nuclear fission)
- {分裂|ぶんれつ}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧ (state of division)
- ⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{分裂|ぶんれつ} (national division)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {分裂|ぶんれつ}: splitting apart with conflict or natural force; often negative
- ⟦{分割|ぶんかつ}→分割：11745_bunkatsu⟧: deliberate, controlled division into parts
- ⟦{分離|ぶんり}→分離：11773_bunri⟧: separation of connected elements; more neutral
